journey: restart API and web after implementation
open Scheduler from the application sidebar
create an owner-scoped interval schedule through the UI
observe timezone, recurrence, next run, and empty occurrence state
run now and observe a real enqueued durable-task occurrence
pause and observe Resume from the persisted API state
cancel and observe terminal occurrence plus delivered notification
limitations: The live journey used cancellation to avoid spending provider tokens; completion notification success and retry are additionally covered by deterministic integration tests.
Axe accessibility automation is reserved for the product-polish cross-feature gate; this stage checked semantics, keyboard-addressable native controls, overflow, and console state.
